justification: `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/parser/ParserFactory.java` is only 32 lines and has one public method plus a private constructor; `getParser()` just switches on `ParserType` and instantiates one of three parser classes (`HotSpotLogParser`, `J9LogParser`, `ZingLogParser`) with no additional state or logic. `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/launch/LaunchHeadless.java` shows it is used only as a construction helper. This is a thin factory, not a class with multiple responsibilities or low cohesion.
